content: नियतिः {%f.%} .²1 Restraint, restriction. .²2 Destiny, fate, luck, fortune (good or bad); (sometimes personified as a goddess, the sister of Āyati, both being daughters of Meru and wives of Dhātṛ and Vidhātṛ); नियतिबलान्नु <ls>Dk.</ls>; नियतेर्नियोगात् <ls>Śi. 4. 34</ls>; <ls>Ki. 2. 12</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">4. 21</ls>. .²3 A religious duty or obligation; नियतिः कारणं लोके नियतिः कर्मसाधनम् . नियतिः सर्वभूतानां नियोगेष्विह कारणम् .. <ls>Rām. 4. 25. 4</ls>. .²4 Self-command, self-restraint.
